reason: I'd grab the 14-day trial since there's no auto-charge, but my real problem is waking up at 3-4am, and the comparison only measures how long it takes me to fall asleep. My AirPods already cut the sound when I'm out, and the free version is ad-free, so after 14 days I'd just keep the free one.
objection: The re-play-when-you-toss feature is the only thing aimed at my 3am wake-ups, and it's labeled as still being tested. I'm not paying 4,900 a month on my salary for something experimental when free sounds plus AirPods already work okay.
would_change_my_mind: If the 14-day report showed I got back to sleep noticeably faster after waking at night, not just faster the first time I fell asleep, I'd consider the yearly plan.
